messages:
clare: Heads up — since ~0200 UTC we started seeing TLS handshake spikes originating from apac ingress after the regional cipher rotation. Failures ~5-8%, clients see 'handshake_failure' / TLS alert 40. Cert chain looks intact when fetched from the edge. Can sec+infra take a look? @oncall-luke

grace: Thanks Clare. I see the alert in prod-obsv too. Correlation shows increased SNI-related errors for services behind keystore-v2 in apac. Pulling logs now.

raj: Quick q — did we change KMS permissions in apac around the rotator rollout? Last week we tightened the keystore role bindings.

sec-bot: rotator-bot: Completed cipher-profile rotation in eu and apac at 2026-03-20T03:12:04Z. Keystore rollout: canary->50%->100%.

infra-ana: Captured tail of edge logs: 
```
TLSHandshake: client=10.11.12.13 sni=svc-payments.apac redacted
alert_level=fatal alert_desc=handshake_failure
keystore_lookup=keystore-v2 apac region
kms_decrypt=DENIED principal=svc-keystore-writer@redwood
```
Looks like a KMS decrypt denial for a keystore worker.

clare: That matches. The rotator updated cipher suites and concurrently we applied a narrower KMS RBAC change for `svc-keystore-writer` on apac keys. Could be a timing issue where new keys aren't accessible to the keystore process.

grace: Steps to triage: 1) confirm KMS denies in audit logs; 2) validate keystore can decrypt private keys locally; 3) if deny true, rollback RBAC or create temporary allow for keystore process. Attaching commands.

grace: Audit check: `gcloud kms keys versions get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/apac/keyRING/apac-keys --format=json | jq .` and `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.iam.admin.v1.SetIamPolicy" AND resource="projects/redwood/locations/apac/keyRING/apac-keys"' --limit 50`

raj: I can confirm IAM change: at 2026-03-20T02:58Z an ACL patch removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from `svc-keystore-writer@redwood`. Change was part of RBAC tidy PR #8123 (infra).

infra-ana: Replayed keystore container locally with apac KMS creds — decrypt fails: `Error: KMS permission denied: projects/redwood/locations/apac/keyRING/apac-keys/cryptoKeys/edge-key`. So service can't unwrap the key; fallback to cached keys exists but TTL was short (5m) and cache expired.

clare: Root cause: concurrent rollout (cipher rotation) + RBAC tightening removed decrypt perms -> some nodes attempted to serve new cipher chain but couldn't decrypt private keys -> handshake fail.

oncall-luke: Proposed mitigations: 
- Immediately restore `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for `svc-keystore-writer@redwood` on apac keys as a hotfix (5-10m).
- Backfill a longer local key cache for keystore-v2 (30m) to cover transient IAM swaps.
- Update rotator to gate final cipher activation on keystore decrypt healthcheck (HTTP 200) across canary nodes.

clare: Agreed. Who can apply the hotfix? This touches IAM — infra-ana?

infra-ana: Applying hotfix now. Will add role for 1h and monitor.

sec-bot: iam-audit-bot: Detected binding change: role cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter added to `svc-keystore-writer@redwood` for resource projects/redwood/locations/apac/keyRING/apac-keys at 2026-03-20T03:18:22Z by infra-ana.

prod-obsv: Observability: handshake failure rate in apac dropped from 6.2% -> 0.7% within 3 minutes of hotfix. Latency normalized.

raj: For follow-ups (postmortem items): 
- Add identity-health (IH) smoke test before rotator completes.
- Document RBAC change window guidance: avoid key-permission removals during cipher/keystore rollouts.
- Make keystore cache TTL configurable per rollout.

grace: Also need audit log retention tweak: keep KMS audit entries for 90 days for regional investigations (currently 30d). I'll open infra ticket.

clare: I'll own the postmortem and timeline. Short-term: confirm no remaining nodes failing (grace, can you run a global probe sweep?), and update runbook to include an immediate RBAC rollback step.

grace: Running probes now — will post results in ~10m.

infra-ana: Filed internal issue INFRA-2026: add pre-rotation keystore decrypt healthcheck + configurable cache TTL.

raj: I'll update the RBAC PR checklist to require stakeholder signoff if key roles are modified within 24h of any keystore/rotator change.

clare: Thanks all. Notes: no customer data exposure observed; this was availability impact only. Postmortem by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
